entities.summary: Max Jean-Gilles is an American former professional football player who was a guard in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Georgia Bulldogs, earning consensus All-American honors in 2005. He was selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the fourth round of the 2006 NFL draft.
